note: The scheduled subsidy per height for the launch-form issuance (IgneumLaunchIssuance in node/params/config_igneum.go: Epoch 6144, EpochDiv 2048, M 10^8 IGN, TailPerEpoch 2,048 IGN, FundBps 100), the first 2,000 heights, printed by the node's own issuance package on a build box at 18:17 UK on 12 October 2026 (tools/evm/schedule/main.go run inside node/ at main de092863). chain 7320 carries this form by the protocol team's withFund entry for its chain id, which names its fund address; until that entry is on main the fund address here is 'the chain's withFund address' and the reader takes it from the chain's config (igneum.issuance.fundAddress in admin_nodeInfo). The hand check for height 1: A_0 = M / 2048 = 48,828,125 IGN, per block floor(A_0 / 6144) = 7,947,285,970,052,083,333 wei, the fund floor(that * 100 / 10000) = 79,472,859,700,520,833 wei, the sealer the rest 7,867,813,110,351,562,500 wei; the remainder A_0 - 6144 x per block = 2,048 wei is paid in block 6144, outside these 2,000 (economics' cross-read of 18:28 UK on main 47aadede corrected an earlier 1,792 here; its replay from recut.py agrees cell for cell over the 2,000 heights). The identity the accounting row reads: amount = fund + sealer, and the sealer's part is split by the payout list (the listed pro rata, the unlisted part unissued) or kept by the coinbase when there is no list (the matrix's section 2.3). The row: the outside review's seventh reading, the security review's reader tools/security/accounting-row.py.
rule_references: node/params/config_igneum.go (IgneumLaunchIssuance; IgneumChainIssuance[chain id] = withFund(..., fund address))
docs/evm/COMPATIBILITY.md section 2.3 (the credit rule's two branches as read on devnet8 and devnet9)
fund_address: the chain's withFund address from its config (devnet8 0x...7318, devnet9 0x...7319; chain 7320's with the protocol team's entry)
schedule: the launch form (EpochDiv): A_e = (M - S_e) / EpochDiv per epoch, floor(A_e / Epoch) per block with the remainder in the epoch's last block, the epoch's subsidy max(TailPerEpoch, A_e); fund = floor(subsidy * FundBps / 10000), sealer = subsidy - fund
